title: A session reads which paths other sessions hold from the backlog, not from messages
goal: backlog.py prints the touches of every claimed item with its claimer (and the claimer's sprint), so a session planning or orchestrating work learns which paths other sessions hold without asking them; the kb-sprint plan step names the command. Answers the SP-bno4xpft retrospective: path locks were negotiated by ad-hoc cross-session messages, one of which expired unread.
